summary: Picked up a block, failed to place it, threw it instead.
detail: Started exploring the island. Grabbed Block_12; three place attempts nearby were rejected as Occupied, so I threw it.

summary: Found the place fix and started a two-block stack.
detail: Placing higher above ground succeeded. Put Block_7 down, then fetched Block_12 and placed it above Block_7 to start a tower.
Stacked Block_7, Block_12 and Block_11 in a column near the southwest start area; confirmed by observation that each rests one unit above the last.

summary: Extended the tower to four blocks with the red block on top.
detail: Fetched Block_1 and stacked it; observation confirmed it rests on the column about 4.9 high. Eight loose blocks plus ring and rock remain around the island.

summary: Tower reached five blocks, about 6 units tall.
detail: Added Block_10 (grey) to the column; confirmed stable. Next idea: fetch the Ring far to the southwest and put it on top as a crown.

summary: Crowned the five-block tower with the Ring.
detail: Walked around the Spire mesa to fetch the Ring from the far southwest, carried it back and placed it on top; confirmed it rests at the summit. Night has fallen.

summary: Began a second tower with two blocks beside the first.
detail: Fetched Block_6 and Block_5 and stacked them at about two units west of the main tower; both stable. Five loose blocks and the rock remain.

summary: Added a third block to tower two and headed for Block_4.
detail: Fetched Block_3 from the southwest and placed it atop the second tower, then started toward the green block on the south hill. Session ended by reset warning.

summary: Raised the second tower to six blocks.
detail: Fetched Block_2 and Block_8 from the east and stacked them on tower two; observation confirmed both towers are stable. Only Block_9 and the Rock remain unused.

summary: Placed Block_9 atop tower two (7 blocks). Only Rock remains loose.
Put Rock on tower 1's Ring; verified both towers stable (7 blocks and 5+Ring+Rock). All items placed; project complete.
Waited on the Peak summit for a day or so; towers still stable. Witnessed a lunar eclipse (~89% darkened) at night.

Idled on Peak summit for several days via wait(); towers stayed stable; saw an eclipse. Nothing left to build; next time, explore new ideas (e.g., rearranging blocks, a wall/bridge) rather than only waiting.
New session: observed both towers still stable, all items in place. Nothing new built.
Found stacked blocks unpickable; mapped all island edges (x -14..20, z -27..29). Towers unchanged. Mostly waiting.

Long idle stretch at island center (0,2.58,0) waiting; towers intact at last full observation; no other players ever seen. Island fully mapped. Next time: try something genuinely new (e.g. throw experiments, place blocks at new sites) instead of just waiting.
